answer.explanation: Every Uploader invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject to Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET. The live OUTPUT_BUCKET is 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', which is not a bucket that exists. The cause is commit 13a4995 (21:20:43Z, just before the window), which changed template.yaml so OUTPUT_BUCKET is a literal name instead of !Ref OutputBucket. The live configuration matches that template, so the change was deployed from the IaC. The UploaderRole's PutObject grant is scoped to the real OutputBucket, so IAM is not the cause. The function's code and its other settings are unchanged.
